description:
Turn on and set up the consent bar for a pixel.

        Changing any setting makes a new policy version, and returning visitors are asked again.
        Returns the policy link and the script tag to put on the site.

contact_channels.description: Optional. How the site owner may contact a visitor who consents. Any of: email, phone, sms, agentic. Example: ["email"]
contact_channels.title: Contact Channels

controller_contact.description: Optional. Email address or web address where visitors can reach the site owner about their data. Shown in the hosted notice. Example: privacy@example.com
controller_contact.title: Controller Contact

controller_jurisdiction.description: Optional. Where the site owner is based, as plain text, such as a country or US state. Shown in the hosted notice. Example: Florida, USA
controller_jurisdiction.title: Controller Jurisdiction

controller_name.description: Name of the business or person that owns the site. It is shown in the consent bar as the party asking the visitor for permission. 1 to 200 characters. Example: Example Shop LLC
controller_name.title: Controller Name

controller_type.description: Optional. One of company, person or organization. Describes the site owner in the hosted notice. Example: company
controller_type.title: Controller Type

data_sharing.description: Optional. true if the site owner shares consented contact data with other parties, false if not. Shown in the hosted notice. Example: false
data_sharing.title: Data Sharing

disclosed_parties.description: Optional. Names of the other parties the site owner wants the hosted notice to list, one name per item. Example: ["Example CRM Inc."]
disclosed_parties.title: Disclosed Parties

pixel_id.description: pixel_id of the pixel to configure. Example: px_7a1b2c3d4e5f6a7b
pixel_id.title: Pixel Id

purposes.description: What the consent bar asks the visitor to allow. One or more of: analytics, resolution, newsletter, email_sharing, phone_sharing, partner_email, partner_calls, partner_sms. Include resolution, or no visitor is ever identified. Example: ["resolution", "analytics"]
purposes.title: Purposes

site_policy_url.description: Optional. HTTPS address of the site's own privacy policy. The bar links to it, and the hosted notice becomes a short add-on about identification. Leave empty to use the hosted notice on its own. Example: https://shop.example.com/privacy
site_policy_url.title: Site Policy Url

name: configure_consent
title: Configure consent and policy
